'''Gennady Chibisov''' ({{langx|ru|Геннадий Чибисов}}; September 23, 1946 – August 7, 2008) was a [[Soviet Union|Soviet]]/[[Russia]]n [[cosmologist]]. He obtained his PhD in 1972, from the [[Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology]], with a thesis entitled "Entropy perturbations in cosmology". He is best known for his 1981 paper
on the origin of cosmological density perturbations from quantum fluctuations, coauthored with [[Viatcheslav Mukhanov]]. This is the earliest of a number of calculations addressing the origin of density fluctuations in [[inflationary cosmology]], which is the most common hypothesis for the origin of the expanding universe and the structure within it.<ref name="Baumann Inflation Lectures">{{cite arXiv|title=Baumann Inflation Lectures|eprint=0907.5424|last1=Baumann|first1=Daniel|class=hep-th|year=2009}}</ref>
The Mukhanov-Chibisov paper was part of the work honoured by the 2013 [[Gruber Prize in Cosmology]].<ref name="2013 Gruber Prize">{{cite web|title=2013 Gruber Prize|url=http://gruber.yale.edu/cosmology/press/2013-gruber-cosmology-prize-press-release|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130714134657/http://gruber.yale.edu/cosmology/press/2013-gruber-cosmology-prize-press-release|url-status=dead|archive-date=July 14, 2013}}</ref>
